
---
applyTo: "tests/**/*.js,js/**/*.js"
---

# Testing Standards

- Verify every Jira acceptance criterion.
- Test adding, viewing, editing and deleting expenses.
- Test category filtering and total calculation.
- Verify LocalStorage persistence after page reload.
- Test required-field validation.
- Test zero, negative, invalid and non-numeric amounts.
- Include positive and negative test scenarios.
- Record actual results in test documentation.
- Report failures honestly; never assume tests passed.
